intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. Four v0.6.0 single-binary Rust desktop and web applications make up my current releases: Ergon (personal employee agent desk hardened across a 96/96 3-company live LLM campaign), Fleet (parallel coding-agent mission control with autonomous Auto-Heal, Playbooks, Board Telemetry, and DAG scheduling), OpenRO (Roblox Studio game builder with 28 game systems, Card Art Studio, playable Anime Card Battles: Rebirth — Apex Edition, and bidirectional .rbxlx XML), and OpenBell (paper-only Kalshi 15-minute quant desk with PAV isotonic recalibration and a $500/day paper capital scaling planner — places no orders; no order-placement code path exists).
